system.description:
When an enemy Strike would make you Dead or put you at Death's Door, and another ally or enemy (not the attacker) is within 10 ft, roll a Luck Check with CR equal to the number of times you have used this ability this Doom Cycle. On success the blow leaves you at 1 Health Point instead. The prevented damage goes to one enemy within 10 ft other than the attacker or, if there is none, to the nearest ally within 10 ft. If no one can take it, you die.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.76

automation.onSuccess: You drop to 1 Health Point instead. Deal the prevented damage to one enemy within 10 ft other than the attacker or, if there is none, to the nearest ally within 10 ft. If no one can take it, you die.

automation.note: Trigger: an enemy Strike that would kill you or put you at Death's Door while another ally or enemy besides the attacker is within 10 ft. The CR is the number of times you have used Cockroach this Doom Cycle, so keep count.
